recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-39148 unless PA later decides to rename or restructure the admission backbone more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-39148 was a Published R5 PA change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether Encounter.admission should be split because the renamed admission backbone still contains discharge information. The approved resolution clarified that Encounter.admission represents details relevant from admittance through discharge, not only the intake event.
initial_application: Git commit 9075007296 applied the issue by changing source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so Encounter.admission.definition uses the approved stay/admittance/discharge wording. The current source still contains that wording.
additional_context: Encounter is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Bounded Jira searches for Encounter.admission and the exact approved definition found no later final core decision that reverses the clarification. PA minutes from 2022-11-09 reference FHIR-39148, and corrected Zulip key search found no directly relevant discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition already states that Encounter.admission covers the stay during which care is provided and explicitly says it is not the event of admitting the patient, preserving the intended meaning while retaining the existing discharge-related child elements.
